text: Monday - Composio Toolkit | Composio All Toolkits Monday MONDAY Latest version 20261101_00 monday.com is a customizable work management platform for project planning, collaboration, and automation, supporting agile, sales, marketing, and more Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth available OAuth2 Frequently Asked Questions Why do I see "App is not installed" when connecting Monday? Monday requires the OAuth app to be installed in the target workspace before users can authorize their accounts. If the app is not installed, Monday can stop the connection flow with an "App is not installed" message. A Monday workspace admin only needs to install the app once per workspace. After the admin approves the installation, users in that workspace can connect their Monday accounts normally. If you are using the Composio-managed Monday app, ask a Monday workspace admin to install it with this link: https://auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=96b038435fc029e045f9ba800e66fefa&response_type=install . We are working on making this flow smoother so developers do not need to manually share the install link. How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Monday.com? Use your own Monday app when you want users to see your app's name on the consent screen and control the credentials yourself. Create the Monday app Sign in to the Monday developer center and click Create App . Give the app a name, such as Composio-Monday . Monday generates a Client ID , Client Secret , and Signing Secret at the bottom of the page. Copy all three. In the app's Redirect URLs section, add https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add with https and no trailing slash. It must exactly match the oauth_redirect_uri field in your Composio auth config. Select the scopes your integration needs, such as boards:read , boards:write , workspaces:read , users:read , and me:read . Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Monday . Set the authentication type to OAuth2 (not Bearer Token) and choose Use your own developer authentication . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret . If New OAuth Flow is enabled for your Monday app, set use_oauth2_1 to true ; leave it false for legacy OAuth 2.0. To use Monday triggers, paste the app's Signing Secret into webhook_signing_secret (it's not the Client Secret). Then click Create Monday Auth Config . Have a Monday workspace admin install your app in the workspace (see the "App is not installed" question above). Then click Connect Account , authorize, and confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. After the OAuth flow completes, Composio stores the access token automatically. How do Monday scopes work? Monday scopes are configured on the Monday OAuth app and picked up during authorization. For the common connection flow, you do not need to configure scopes separately in the auth config. If you are using the Composio-managed Monday app, use the default scope setup. If you are creating your own Monday OAuth app, configure the scopes you need in Monday. If you intentionally want to request only a subset of the OAuth app's scopes, configure that subset in the auth config; otherwise, leave the auth config scope field alone.
